description.value: The Kensington Branch is a neighborhood outpost of the Vancouver Public Library system, serving the Cedar Cottage area of East Vancouver. It sits within a community hub and offers the full range of public library services. For a touring cyclist cutting through East Vancouver, it is a convenient landmark with potential for a rest break in a climate-controlled public space.
